mission.title: Honor Among Thieves
mission.description: Unmask the Zion imposter posing as Espion and recover the stolen insecticide.

npc.say: Don't let Eos bother you. He...she -- whatever it is -- isn't much of a conversationalist.
The Merovingian wants some of us more like Eos. I guess it gives the Merovingian more chances to blab about his wife.
I heard about your work on Aten. Life is good when those Zion nut jobs are put in their place.

phase.briefing:
An unknown Zion redpill, operating under the name "Espion," has just stolen a stash of the coveted insecticide. To make matters worse, a small band of worthless Exiles fell for the redpill's pathetic disguise.
Your assignment is to uncover the identity of Espion by beating it out of Tanner Clark. Once you have the imposter's true identity, find this person, and eliminate Espion -- or whatever they call themselves... After you've done this, recover the insecticide, and make an example of the inadequate Exiles. Is that clear? I truly hope so.

enter.say:
What makes Flood think this Tanner Clark guy knows anything? Where does he get this information, anyway?
Maybe...I shouldn't ask.

done.say: I'm sorry, guv. Do I know ya? Who? Espion? Sorry, don't know anyone by that handle... Cheers.
Tanner Clark is lying. Kill his friend. Now.
Tanner Clark should be more cooperative now.

Smeggin' hell! Fine, I'll fill ya in... Jus'--just let me live!
This Zion chap named Aten came to me looking for help on an inside job. The redpill wanted to pose as some Exile bloke named Espion. I said I could make it happen for the right price... All I got was a name and some small details saved on this CD -- that's it!
You can have the CD. Just leave me be, alright?
Tanner Clark has a computer in another room. You can search the contents of that CD on his computer. Do this now.

objective.text: Put the CD into Tanner Clark's computer

done.say: Tracking Aten's RSI signal has proven futile, so we need to get a lead on Aten's current position. Run a search for "Espion" and "Aten" on Tanner Clark's computer

objective.text: Search the computer for Espion and Aten

done.say: {player}, there's one last piece of business to conduct before we move on: kill Tanner Clark.
The Merovingian has a "zero witnesses" policy at the moment, and this includes our cooperative comrade. I am glad that this was not a problem for you.

near.say: Listen up, you! You can't just barge in here and walk around like you own the place! That... that isn't right!

phase.briefing:
The Zion-sucking neomongers have mustered up far more trouble than they can handle. Revenge must be exacted on the insignificant wretch who thought they could pose as Espion. While we can't track Aten's RSI, we can track the dossier mentioned in Aten's email -- it's been in our hands before.
Assassinate Aten and recover the insecticide. It could be in Aten's hands, or someone else's. Just to be on the safe side, check everyone's pockets.

enter.say: The Merovingian sure wants a lot of folks dead... That doesn't ever get tiresome, does it?

done.say: I was right! Check Broomfondle's pockets for the insecticide -- and loose change while you're at it.

objective.text: Get the insecticide from Broomfondle's body

near.say:
Ah! You found me!
I'm not going down without a fight.
My scans say Broomfondle has the insecticide. You can always try beating it out of him.
You just made a big mistake.
Beats the hell outta me, boss.

phase.briefing:
You've surprised me, {player}. Thankfully, the rest of your assignment is far simpler than the preceding tasks.
Bring the insecticide to Eos at that address.

enter.say: I hear Eos is a Nightmare. Have you ever met one before? Scary.

mission.finish:
Your efforts are proving most beneficial, {player}.
You will hear from me again. Don't get too comfortable.
